stories.title: AI investors or casino gamblers? What Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said that sparked sharp global AI selloff
stories.summary: Global AI stocks plunged after Broadcom CEO Hock Tan warned that investors are treating artificial intelligence like gambling, raising concerns about excessive valuations and unsustainable spending. South Korea’s Kospi and Japan’s Nikkei declined, while Indian IT stocks rallied amid the global technology selloff.

stories.title: Global Market: BoE's Megan Greene says UK interest rates may not be restrictive enough
stories.summary: Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the IMF’s upward revision to the UK’s economic growth forecast supports her view that monetary policy remains insufficiently restrictive. She warned that delaying interest rate hikes could prolong inflationary pressures, highlighting divisions among policymakers over balancing inflation control against economic growth and borrowing costs.

stories.title: Rupee makes stunning comeback: What is RBI’s 4-step plan?
stories.summary: The rupee staged a stunning comeback, gaining nearly Re 1 against the dollar after the RBI rolled out a four-step package to curb currency pressure. From a dedicated dollar window to tighter forex derivatives rules and higher hedging costs, here’s what the RBI’s moves mean for the rupee — and whether the relief rally can last.

stories.title: Mukul Agarwal adds 470% multibagger to Rs 8,000 crore portfolio, trims KRN Heat exposure
stories.summary: Ace investor Mukul Agarwal added a 1.2% stake in precision engineering firm Apsis Aerocom, which has surged 470% since its March 2026 debut, to his Rs 8,000 crore portfolio. Meanwhile, he trimmed his stake in KRN Heat Exchanger following a 61% rally over the past year.

stories.title: Jio IPO may trigger Reliance’s next big re-rating. Why Religare sees 47% upside
stories.summary: Reliance Industries could see a valuation re-rating as Jio Platforms’ proposed Rs 30,000 crore IPO brings greater transparency to its digital business. Religare has a target price of Rs 1,696 on the stock, implying 46.7% upside from its current market price.

stories.title: Global Market: Hong Kong dollar nears weak side of trading band, raising prospect of HKMA intervention
stories.summary: The Hong Kong dollar neared the weak end of its trading band against the US dollar, raising the possibility of Hong Kong Monetary Authority intervention to defend its peg. Hong Kong maintains a linked exchange rate system that keeps the local currency within a narrow range of 7.75 to 7.85 per US dollar.

stories.title: Mortgage hedging adds selling pressure to US Treasury market as yields surge
stories.summary: Rising US Treasury yields and mortgage rates have triggered increased mortgage-related hedging, adding selling pressure to the bond market. However, analysts expect the impact to remain limited compared with previous selloffs, as refinancing incentives decline and the mortgage market shrinks.

stories.title: The Andaman Islands could be India's next big trade trump card
stories.summary: India is focusing on strengthening the Andaman and Nicobar Islands' strategic maritime role for regional trade. The upcoming Andaman Dialogue 2027 will emphasize maritime infrastructure and economic cooperation among countries in the Indo-Pacific region.

stories.title: Rupee jumps 177 paise in 2 days against dollar after RBI's strong defence before Rs 97 goal post. What lies ahead?
stories.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened 177 paise against the US dollar in two days to 94.06 following aggressive RBI market interventions. Key steps include a special dollar window for oil firms and tighter forex derivative rules to defend the Rs 97 level, though macro risks and FII outflows remain.

stories.title: Bumble’s billion-dollar buyout: Why investors are betting on a turnaround
stories.summary: Bumble shares surged nearly 50% on Monday after reports that the dating-app operator was in advanced talks to be taken private by Ithaca Holdings in a deal valuing the company at around $1 billion. Bumble's reported buyout valuation marks a dramatic decline from its approximately $14 billion valuation around its 2021 stock market debut.

stories.title: Warren Buffett became a millionaire at 32. What he advises youth trying to copy his success
stories.summary: Warren Buffett became a millionaire at 32 and has inspired many through his investing journey. Buffett used the metaphor of a 'snowball' to illustrate building wealth gradually.

stories.title: AI traders behaving like casino gamblers? What made chip trade toxic and why that’s good news for India
stories.summary: Global AI stock enthusiasm hit a roadblock as South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.4% on chip competition concerns and Broadcom's warning on AI spending. Conversely, Indian IT stocks surged, adding Rs 26,000 crore in market cap as investors rotated into services over semiconductor hardware exposure.

stories.title: Groww Q2 results preview: MOFSL sees 41% revenue growth; margins, derivatives business in focus
stories.summary: Billionbrains Garage Ventures is poised to unveil its Q2FY27 results, projecting impressive revenue growth compared to the previous year. Analysts from Motilal Oswal Financial Services anticipate revenues reaching Rs 1,434 crore.

stories.title: SBI Research calls for abolition of LTCG tax on equities to boost foreign capital inflows
stories.summary: According to SBI Research, removing the long-term capital gains tax on equities could revitalize investment levels. SBI Research has proposed scrapping the long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax on equities and extending the holding period to two to three years to boost capital inflows and investor sentiment amid sustained FPI outflows.

stories.title: Gold prices rise to Rs 1.50 lakh/10g; silver gains ahead of US economic data. Key levels to track
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices opened higher on MCX as investors awaited US inflation data for clues on the Federal Reserve’s rate outlook, while a firm dollar and geopolitical tensions kept precious metals volatile. Precious metals navigate a crucial week as inflation data and geopolitical tensions shape market sentiment.

stories.title: SpaceX Stock: Why Wall Street sees more upside ahead
stories.summary: SpaceX is reportedly seeking around $40 billion in financing to purchase Nvidia chips, highlighting the scale of its AI computing ambitions. Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas has maintained a bullish stance on SpaceX, with a $300 price target in an earlier October research call.

stories.title: Ircon International shares jump 7% on Rs 862 crore railway EPC contract win
stories.summary: Ircon International shares surged after the company secured an EPC contract worth Rs 862.46 crore from East Central Railway. The project involves track-related works, including laying and linking railway tracks and supplying materials for the third and fourth lines under the Son Nagar–Andal project.

stories.title: India bonds rise as investors see value after 10-year yield nears 7.40%
stories.summary: After hitting a three-year peak, the benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield took a slight dip. In a significant financial shift, India's government bond yields have hit a three-and-a-half-year high of 7.39%, primarily due to the central bank's strategy to minimize liquidity.

stories.title: Bandhan Bank shares jump 7% as Abu Dhabi’s IHC explores stake in promoter Bandhan Financial Services
stories.summary: Bandhan Bank shares jumped nearly 7% after reports that Abu Dhabi-based IHC was in early-stage discussions to acquire a promoter stake in Bandhan Financial Services, potentially giving existing investors an exit opportunity. Bandhan Bank draws investor interest as reports point to a potential stake sale by its promoter.

stories.title: Rs 26,340 crore added in minutes! Why HCL Tech, TCS and other IT stocks rallied up to 7%
stories.summary: Indian IT stocks rallied up to 7%, with the Nifty IT index gaining 3.3%, as concerns over rising AI investment costs and uncertain returns rattled global technology stocks. Separately, OpenAI told investors its September annualised revenue was nearly $50 billion, below its earlier indicated figure of $70 billion.

stories.title: India, America expanding cooperation across sectors: US ambassador Sergio Gor
stories.summary: Kolkata and the United States are strengthening ties across sectors such as defence, IT, and healthcare. Recent military exercises involving 500 troops and significant investments showcase this growing partnership.

stories.title: Blackstone COO flags tech disruption, geopolitical conflicts as global risks; says India's investment climate improving
stories.summary: He stressed India's progress in infrastructure and foreign investment, which enhance growth prospects. Blackstone President and COO Jonathan Gray said technology-driven disruption, geopolitical conflicts and rising government debt pose key risks to the global economy, while improving infrastructure and investment conditions are bolstering India’s growth prospects.

stories.title: PM Modi's free trade push could lead to $140 billion GDP gain for India
stories.summary: A more protectionist US could unexpectedly benefit India as New Delhi expands its free-trade agreements (FTAs) to diversify export markets and attract investment. A World Trade Organization-based model estimates that India’s concluded and proposed trade deals, including agreements with the EU and New Zealand, could add about $140 billion to GDP by 2035, lifting it 1.7% above the baseline.

stories.title: IMF raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
stories.summary: The International Monetary Fund has increased India's economic growth projections for FY27 and FY28 to 7%. India's GDP growth reached 7.8% in FY26, exceeding expectations during the April-June quarter.

stories.title: IMF sees India bucking global slowdown, raises 2026 growth forecast to 7%
stories.summary: IMF has increased India's growth forecast for 2026 due to stronger-than-expected economic momentum. International Monetary Fund has increased its growth forecast for India to 7% for 2026 (AI generated image)

stories.summary: Farmers in India are likely to reduce wheat planting this winter due to water scarcity and low minimum support prices. Regions such as Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh may see the most significant impact from these conditions.

WindBorne, founded in 2015 and based in Redwood City, California, is one of the first organizations to directly feed empirical data into a deep-learning weather model.

stories.summary: "The quantity of 5,841 MT of sugar to be exported to the EU from India under TRQ (tariff rate quota) for the year 2026-27 (October 2026 to September 2027) has been notified," the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has said in a public notice dated October 9.

stories.summary: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Food Minister Pralhad Joshi held detailed discussions at the Pusa campus with a delegation of farmers from the two major sugarcane-growing states. About 80-90 farmers from different organisations attended, along with state ministers.

stories.summary: Honeyjar, which will be attending this week’s TechCrunch Disrupt as part of the Startup Battlefield 200, wants to use AI to make the expertise and judgment of the best PR pros available to everyone, including founders who have no idea where to start. “Honeyjar can find reporters, build media lists, scan news and social, track coverage, and surface opportunities,” she said.
